verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a built-in AI assistant across several surfaces: a conversational chat on the incident page, a conversational agent on mobile, and Rootly AI in Slack, which accepts delegated commands like "Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident." It also ships an AI SRE that investigates incidents and recommends next steps, with read-only AWS and Atlassian connectors, plus AI-drafted summaries and retrospectives. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI assistant, and fuller documentation of action-taking delegation (the web chat is explicitly read-only, and write actions are shown by only one Slack example).
